changelog:
html-shot 1.1.0 adds icon set generation, SVG support, and palette/bit-depth options.

- Adds `icons.mjs`: generate favicon and app icon sets from an HTML or SVG design.
- Input can now be an SVG file as well as HTML or URL.
- New options: `--palette` and `--colors` for paletted PNG outputs (2/4/16/256 colors).
- Example starter templates for favicon/app icon (`icon.example.html`) and README translations added.
- Documentation updated to reflect new features and entry points.
- Tag and description updated for icon and SVG support.
- Deprecated `skill-card.md` removed.
summary: Use when a design has to become image assets through a real browser — an og:image or social preview card, an HTML/CSS or SVG design exported as PNG/JPEG/WebP, a screenshot of a page or of one element in it, or a favicon / app-icon set (.ico, .icns, apple-touch, PWA) for a site, Electron or Tauri app. Also use when a card's copy is CJK, emoji or mixed-script and bundling a font is not an option, or when an og image, favicon or logo raster needs regenerating after a design change.
